get.summary:
On-demand measurements of this service's own mount namespace and cgroup.
`pass` is the same verdict as `/health/live`.
The process answers and its serving-path heartbeat is fresh.

The API can serve requests, including configuration during bootstrap.
Proxmox availability is reported by the operations that need it.
What the server's Proxmox token can do with the stored configuration.
get.description:
Asks Proxmox (`GET /access/permissions`) for the token's privileges on
every ACL path the operations need, then lists per operation what is
required and what is missing. Changes need privileges on the instance's
pool (`HOMESTACK_PVE_POOL`). `installation` says which of the objects
`deploy/pve/homestack-pve.sh install` makes the token can see.

502.description: Proxmox rejected the request or answered unusably

get.summary: The stored `server.toml`, as uploaded.

put.description:
The body is `server.toml`. Send `If-None-Match: *` for the first upload
and `If-Match: "<config_version>"` (or `*`) afterwards. The text is
validated like Python's `config.load_config` and stored atomically; the
previous file is kept as a backup. Uploading the stored text again
changes nothing.

412.description: The stored version is not the one in If-Match, or a configuration exists despite If-None-Match

428.description: Neither If-Match nor If-None-Match: * was sent

get.summary: Version of the stored configuration, to compare instances.

get.summary:

(commands through the guest agent; skipped without
`VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted` on Gold). The account checks use `[user]` of
the configuration, or the installer's defaults (`user`, 1000:1000) before
one is uploaded. A stopped Gold is not started.

get.summary: Progress is served from memory so startup need not repeat inventory reads.
Jobs kept by this server instance, newest first.
One job.

WebSocket: a `snapshot` of the job, a `job` message after every change
(the last one finished), and a `heartbeat` whenever nothing changed for
five seconds. The server closes the stream after the final state.
Messages: `StreamMessage`.
Network profiles a workspace could use, for the Gold VM's bridge.

Set the Proxmox token: the body is `USER@REALM!TOKENID=SECRET`. The
server uses it at once and at every start. Never readable.

Replace the certificate Caddy serves, then make Caddy load it. If Caddy

parameters.name: parallel

502.description: Proxmox rejected the request or answered unusably

digest.description: The `digest` of the plan the client reviewed.

oneOf.description:
What the plan's `summary.secrets_required` names, and nothing else.
Secrets are never part of a plan, a job or a log.

ApplySecrets.description: Secrets an operation needs to run (decision 6).

luks_passphrase.description: The passphrase of the LUKS layer `workspace.resize` grows.

config_version.description: Configuration the ACL paths were derived from.

installation.description:
What `deploy/pve/homestack-pve.sh install` makes, as far as the token
can see it.

token_id.description: The server's Proxmox token, `USER@REALM!TOKENID` (never the secret).

changed.description: `false` when the text was already stored; nothing was written then.

config_version.description: SHA-256 of the stored text, also sent as the `ETag`.

SHA-256 of the stored `server.toml`, lowercase hex; `null` before the
first upload.

Container.description: Resource usage of the cgroup v2 the service process runs in.

capacity_cpus.description:
Logical CPUs the cgroup may use: its cpuset, lowered by any visible
`cpu.max` quota.

oneOf.description: `null` when the cpu controller is not enabled for the cgroup.

usage_usec.description: Cumulative kernel counters; consumers compute rates between reports.

DeployedService.description:
A manifest-defined service in a container, as HomeStack's description
records it; an observation, never ownership proof.

gold_candidates.description:
VMs tagged `homestack-gold`: `vmid`, `name`, `node`, `status`, `tags`
where Proxmox reports them.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes of the HomeStack API.

field.description:
The configuration field a `config_invalid` error is about, e.g.
`repo.owner`.

available_bytes.description: Free space available to an unprivileged application user.

mounted.description: Whether mountinfo confirms this exact path as a mount point.

oneOf.description: The configured Gold VM; `null` when it does not exist (see `warnings`).

others.description:
The other VMs and containers of the HomeStack pools (more Golds,
the servers), by VMID.

pools.description: The HomeStack pools the server's token sees, by ID.

workspaces.description: Workspaces (`homestack-ws`) and alien VMs (`homestack-alien`), by VMID.

GuestBackup.description: Newest backup actually present in the readable backup storage inventory.

HomeUsage.description:
Persistent home capacity/usage. Without filesystem measurements only
`size_bytes` from the VM disk or LXC mount configuration is known.

physical_available_bytes.description: Always `null`; kept for the CLI's output shape.

ImageCheckProgress.description: Whether the server is currently discovering or checking container images.

ImageUpdate.description: Cached registry check for a managed container's image.

checked_at.description: Last successful check, in RFC 3339 UTC.

error.description: A failed check preserves the last successful result.

Installation.description: The Proxmox objects of a HomeStack installation the server can check.

complete.description: No check is `missing` (`unknown` ones are left to the install script).

pool.description: The pool this instance changes workspaces in (`HOMESTACK_PVE_POOL`).

Io.description: Cumulative block I/O counters, summed over devices.

log.description: The last lines of the Proxmox task logs (at most 200).

result.description: What the operation returns on success.

code.description:
`operation_failed`, or an API error code such as
`pve_permission_denied`.

JobProgress.description: The latest transfer progress of a running task.

JobStep.description: A named step of a job, as Python's `start_step` / `finish_step`.

JobTask.description: A Proxmox task the job started or waited for.

exitstatus.description: `OK`, `WARNINGS: N` or the error, once stopped.

ok.description: Whether the capacity could be read.

Liveness.description: Body of the health endpoints. Remote dependencies are not liveness checks.

anon_bytes.description: Anonymous memory of all processes in the cgroup.

limit_bytes.description:
The lowest visible `memory.max`; `null` when unlimited or set outside
the visible hierarchy.

process_rss_bytes.description: Resident set of the service process alone.

usage_bytes.description: `memory.current`: everything charged to the cgroup, page cache included.

NetworkCandidate.description: One network profile a workspace could use (`GET /v1/networks`).

source.description: Where it was found, e.g. `HomeStack workspace VM 200`.

NodeState.description:
A cluster node and whether Proxmox reports it online, with the load
`GET /nodes` reports for an online node.

Operation.description: A HomeStack operation whose Proxmox privileges the server checks.

OperationCapability.description: Whether the token can perform one operation.

available.description: Required privileges are granted and Gold is configured when the operation needs it.

missing.description: The required privileges the token does not have.

required.description: Every privilege the operation needs, sorted by path and name.

OrphanVolume.description: A HomeStack volume (`vm-<vmid>-hs-(root|home)-<name>`) no visible VM references.

Plan.description: A plan: what an operation would do, computed from the cluster now.

digest.description:
SHA-256 (hex) of the operation, its parameters, targets and summary.
Applying needs it, and the plan made again before execution must
have the same one.

expires_at.description: After this the plan cannot be applied.

summary.description: What will be done, as the operation describes it.

targets.description: VMIDs the operation changes; one job at a time per VM.

parameters.description: The operation's parameters; each operation documents its own.

PoolInfo.description: A pool and its comment (the name shown for it).

Pressure.description:
Pressure stall information: time stalled on contention, not utilization.
A resource is `null` when the kernel does not provide PSI for it.

Privilege.description: A Proxmox privilege on an ACL path.

oneOf.description: Only available where the kernel reports a full-stall line.

avg10.description: Percent of wall time stalled over the last 10, 60 and 300 seconds.

PveVersion.description: Proxmox VE version, as returned by `GET /version`.

error.description: A stable error code; never a raw OS error containing private paths.

sample_uptime_usec.description:
Monotonic microseconds since process start when the returned
measurement began; `null` while none exists.

status.description: Process liveness, independent of dependency readiness.

uptime_seconds.description: Seconds since this application process started, on a monotonic clock.

ServiceRates.description:
Counter deltas of two service reports divided by the time between their
measurements. A metric is `null` when either report lacks its counter.

cpu_percent.description: CPU time per wall time of the cgroup; 100 is one logical CPU busy.

StatusEntry.description: One VM in the global status.

oneOf.description: Home capacity/usage; `null` when no home configuration is available.

image.description: The OCI image recorded by HomeStack in the container description.

ip.description: Workspace address, or the actual static `net0` address for a container.

pool.description: The pool it is in; `null` for none.

oneOf.description: Root disk capacity/usage; usage only when measured.
The service HomeStack deployed in this container, from its description.

Rates derived from this and the previous `service_status` of the same
process; `null` until a valid pair exists.
Optional in-container measurements; observations, never ownership proof.

status.description: Proxmox status (`running`, `stopped`, `unknown` on an offline node).

tags.description: Its Proxmox tags, in their order.

orphan_scan_complete.description:
`false` when a node or storage that holds HomeStack volumes could not
be scanned.

oneOf.description:
The cluster's name and quorum (`GET /cluster/status`); absent on a
standalone node or when Proxmox denies the request.

root_storage.description: Capacity of the configured node's default storage.

StorageOverview.description: Extended inventory read independently of the main status.

StorageStatus.description: A local storage on one node, or a shared storage listed once for all nodes.

server_instance_id.description: Changes when the server restarts; streams are not replayed.

TlsCertificate.description: Body of `PUT /v1/secrets/tls`: the certificate Caddy serves, PEM.

actual_hostname.description: From the guest agent, when the VM runs and the agent answers.

actual_ip.description: `address/prefix` of the first IPv4 address on the primary virtual NIC (`net0`).

home_label.description: Expected `HS_HOME_<vmid>` filesystem label or virtiofs tag.

home_mount_ok.description: A mounted filesystem has the expected ext4 label or virtiofs tag.

home_serial.description: `serial=` of the home disk in the VM config.
